scenes.title: 園區入口，她回頭招手
scenes.beat_zh: 一進園區，她回頭對你笑、招手。
scenes.action: The woman stands just inside the amusement park entrance with her body turned toward the right of the frame, where the park lies, looking back over her shoulder at the viewer with a bright open smile, one hand raised in a small wave.

scenes.lighting: golden late-afternoon sunlight from the side, the warm bulbs glowing, bright and clear, her face fully lit

video.description: The woman in the first frame, in her dark brown leather jacket with a cream shearling collar and blue jeans under the arch of warm light bulbs, looks back over her shoulder at the viewer with a bright smile and gives a small wave. Right away The woman (S1), in a clear, warm voice with a natural Taiwanese Mandarin accent, says: <d>[Chinese] 好久沒來遊樂園了！</d> Then she beckons toward the park with her raised hand and shifts a half step toward the right while her face and chest stay turned toward the viewer. Her hair moves slightly in the breeze and the bulbs glow steadily. Her movements make only quiet, light sounds. The camera holds a steady shot.

scenes.beat_zh: 第一個玩什麼？她指著前面的設施，等你決定。
scenes.action: The woman has just walked in toward the right and is turning back to the viewer in mid-step, pointing with one outstretched arm toward the rides on the right of the frame, eyebrows raised in a playful questioning smile.

video.description: The woman in the first frame, in her dark brown leather jacket with a cream shearling collar and blue jeans, keeps pointing toward the rides on the right with her hands empty and looks at the viewer with raised eyebrows and a playful questioning smile. The woman (S1), in a clear, warm voice with a natural Taiwanese Mandarin accent, says: <d>[Chinese] 一開始就這麼刺激？好！</d> Then she laughs with her eyes open and bright and holds a warm smile toward the viewer. The roller coaster track, the carousel and the Ferris wheel stay in place behind her. The camera holds a steady shot.

continuity: Time of day only moves forward: late afternoon (1-2) -> sunset (3) -> dusk (4) -> blue dusk (5) -> night (6). Same outfit in every shot. The pink cotton candy appears in shots 3-5 and nowhere else. The park lies to the right of the frame in every shot: she faces, walks, points and looks to the right. Each shot's first frame shows the motion the previous shot ended on (enters_on = the previous exits_on). The Ferris wheel is in every shot and only gets closer. Neighbouring shots alternate medium and close framing; both candidates of a shot use that shot's framing. Each shot's sound ends with the first sound of the next place.
